feedback.comment: Dr. Iftikhar Ali provided exceptional care for my knee ligament tear. The targeted physical therapy and strengthening helped me get back on the field.
Suffered from excruciating lower back and leg pain for months. After manual therapy and spine decompression at SPORC Clinic on Murree Road, I am completely pain-free.
My mother was unable to walk due to severe knee osteoarthritis. Dr. Iftikhar Ali's rehabilitation plan improved her mobility tremendously without surgery.
Regained 100% range of motion in my left shoulder after 6 sessions of manual therapy and therapeutic exercises. Highly professional facility.
Excellent rehabilitation after my ankle surgery. State-of-the-art gym equipment and one-on-one attention from the physiotherapist.
Continuous desk work had caused severe cervical stiffness and headaches. The posture correction and cervical traction gave instant relief.
